name: comm
summary: Compare two sorted files line by line: lines only in the first, only in the second, and in both

options.description: leave out the lines only in the first file
leave out the lines only in the second file
leave out the lines in both files
stop with an error at the first line out of sorted order
do not check that the input is sorted
separate the columns with STR instead of a tab
end with a line counting each column
lines end in NUL, not newline

notes: Lines compare byte by byte, as in the C.UTF-8 locale. Exit status 1 when the input was not sorted.

messages.notSorted: file {n} is not in sorted order
messages.inputNotSorted: input is not in sorted order
